verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management and issue-tracking platform, and restoring an AI coding agent's session checkpoints belongs to the coding-agent product category. The evidence shows Shortcut only connects to external agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI through its MCP server. Nothing shows Shortcut itself runs agent sessions or keeps checkpoint version history for them, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
